title: TrailsBuiltEvent
description: Carried on trails.built. Summary only; full membership fetched via the Trail Builder API.

domain.description: the domain this snapshot/event belongs to (e.g. `core-ip`); a snapshot belongs to exactly one domain. Optional for backward-compat; consumers default to the single MVP domain when absent.

trailIds.description: Array of trail identifiers built in this snapshot.

trailCount.description: Number of trails built (must equal trailIds.length).
